body: Integration fix fc47b97 on space-sprint-1 (orchestrator, via helper FireguardInterrupt, reviewed twice by FireguardFixReview): Fireguard's warm Vitest lane lost the deciding failure when two workers failed at once (Vitest 4.1.12 bail: a second cancel force-stops workers and drops unsent results), so mutation runs ended 'interrupted' and the lane threw `vitest interrupted 3 runs in a row` (DM-198 run 2). Reproduced in both the single-project (pre-DM-273) and two-project configs: not caused by DM-273. Fix: lane runs with bail:0, records failures in a reporter and cancels once; retry removed. Also: on Windows killTree waits for the whole tree to end (PowerShell handle wait, taskkill fallback) so lanes.close() no longer hits EBUSY (DM-198 run 1). Tests in fireguard/test/lanes.test.ts and runnerTimeout.test.ts; load-tested 112/112 at 16 concurrent copies. Accepted costs for the retro: a mutant that fails then hangs synchronously in the same file waits out testTimeoutMs; a Windows timeout kill costs ~0.6 s (more under load).
